observed.caption: A crowd gathers in an urban plaza lined with green hedges and young trees, surrounded by multi-story commercial buildings with colorful billboards under overcast daylight.
observed.description: A wide urban plaza with a low manicured green hedge in the foreground and several young leafy trees planted in a row behind it, a paved open area behind the hedge where a group of approximately 30 people in casual clothing are standing and walking, a modern multi-story building with a glass facade and dark supports on the left, a weathered light-colored commercial building with balconies and large colorful billboards with Japanese characters in the center background, additional low buildings on the right with a yellow banner, a red vertical sign on a pillar near the left building, an overcast pale sky above, and a road curb with a metal drainage grate at the bottom right.
